messages:
sahil: heads-up — ran the long-context bakeoff for the new v2 model with SmoothQuant + activation balancing at ~128k effective context and saw reproducible quality spikes when the KV cache evicted mid-generation.

maya: can you paste the run command and the metric trace?

sahil: sure. command we used: ```./run_bench.sh --model v2-sq --quant smoothquant --act-balance on --seq-len 128000 --batch 1 --kv-evict-threshold 0.8 --profile trace.json```

sahil: key observation: BLEU/ROUGE-style proxy drops ~7-9% after first eviction event, but perplexity only rises slightly. outputs become short and repetitive after the eviction boundary.

alex: interesting. does this only hit FP8 path or INT8 too?

sahil: reproduced on both quant paths. FP8 shows larger degradation (~9%) vs INT8 (~5%), but INT8 has higher variance across seeds.

jen: did you try toggling prefix caching or disabling act-balancing?

sahil: yes. disabling activation-aware scaling removes the spike but overall baseline quality is worse pre-eviction. so act-balancer helps until eviction happens. disabling KV eviction (i.e., larger cache) eliminates the regression.

igor: could be a shift in activation distribution after eviction that interacts with the SQ scaling factors — model expects cached prefix KV with applied scaling, eviction forces recompute under different numeric regime.

maya: can you attach a short excerpt of the trace around the eviction event? even 10 lines will help.

sahil: pasted: ```TRACE SNAPSHOT t=120.34s: seq=81920, evict_idx=65536, evicted_layers=[attn.kv,ffn.kv] metrics: token_loss=1.12, token_ppl=3.06, out_len=1024.  t=120.40s: post-evict recompute step token_loss=1.91, token_ppl=6.75, out_len=96, repeat_ratio=0.43```

bench-bot: perf-report: avg_latency_pre=42ms avg_latency_post=46ms token_cost_pre=0.012 tok_cost_post=0.011 (note: cost slightly down but quality worse)

jen: repeat_ratio 0.43 is huge. wonder if the kv cache eviction causes an implicit attention mask change? any masking bugs?

alex: also check whether we re-apply act-scaling when reconstructing KV on eviction path. might be a double-scale or missed scale.

igor: i dug into the runtime patch: the kernel that reconstructs KV on eviction uses an optimized path that currently assumes FP32 accumulator. when we do quant->dequant->requant for FP8, the scaling factor origin differs. possible mismatch.

maya: can we run an isolated micro-repro that forces eviction at smaller seq len (e.g., 16k) so we can iterate faster?

sahil: yes, did that: same behavioral pattern at 16k but delta smaller. command: ```./run_bench.sh --seq-len 16384 --kv-evict-threshold 0.5``` produced similar loss jump.

alex: action items: 1) sahil to create minimal repro to force eviction at low seq len (due EOD) 2) igor to add asserts on scaling factors during KV rebuild path and dump per-layer scales (tomorrow) 3) jen to run FP32 reference on same seq boundary for oracle baseline (tomorrow).

jen: also will try an experiment: keep act-scaling but disable re-quant on rebuild (i.e., rebuild in FP32 and keep FP32 in cache) to see if numeric compression is root cause.

bench-bot: note: test-tagging applied -> tag: longctx-kv-evict-reg-2157778888

maya: any immediate mitigation for deploy? can add a fallback to disable eviction for Dedicated customers with latency SLAs, but that's expensive. maybe auto-increase kv cache size when act-aware quant enabled?

sahil: agreed. provisional mitigation: conservative eviction threshold for quantized models, and set an ops-level guard to force re-apply act-scaling after rebuild.

igor: one more note: logs show a few layers with near-zero scale factors after quant calibration on some inputs — that amplifies numeric instability on re-quant. we should clip scales to a small floor during calibration.

maya: great. once repro is in a PR we'll add a small eval harness that injects eviction events and validates rouge/quality delta < 2%.

alex: thanks — keep the thread updated. i'll sync with infra about adding a quick CI job for 16k eviction repros. :thumbsup:

sahil: uploaded minimal repro to run: link: https://internal.redwood/repo/longctx/repro/2157778888 in case someone wants to pull it.

jen: leaving a follow-up: if we confirm act-scaling + eviction interplay is the root cause, we should include this as a known caveat in the quantized model onboarding checklist (docs + auto-checks).

maya: good call. ok team, will triage tomorrow in standup. thanks everyone. :coffee:
